title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: Over 3000 raccoon dogs (Nyctereutes procyonoides) live in Shanghai's bustling urban districts with ongoing population expansion. Recognizing species' scale dependent needs underpins sustainable wildlife management. Full details are available in the article by Li et al, https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2664.70586.

Photo: Xiaodong Sun.
